title: Robbery at gunpoint at Palakkad jewellery; three men flee with ornaments
content: Palakkad: Three men armed with guns and a knife robbed a jewellery shop at Peringottukurissi in Palakkad on Friday afternoon, fleeing with around 20 sovereigns of gold ornaments after threatening the staff. The robbery took place at Ishan Jewellery around 2.40 pm. According to CCTV footage, the three men entered the shop and sat on chairs provided for customers. They enquired about gold ornaments before one of them pointed a gun at the employees while another brandished a knife. The staff attempted to resist the robbers. Hearing the commotion, one staff member, Babitha, ran to call the shop owner, K V Sanad, while another staff member, Divya, picked up a chair and fought back. Meanwhile, one of the robbers took two cases of gold ornaments, while the other took two cases displayed in the shop. The trio then fled with the stolen jewellery. At the time of the incident, Sanad, his wife V Divya and two other employees were present in the shop. Divya and Babitha were at the counter, while Sanad and another employee were having food at the back of the jewellery shop. "We were having food in the back. When they saw us, they pulled out a gun and fired. Two of them had guns. Three people had entered inside," Sanad told the media. The staff said the robbers spoke in Hindi. Ishan Jewellery is attached to Sanad's residence. Kodayi police have recorded statements from the jewellery shop staff and launched an investigation. The identities of the robbers have not yet been established. An officer told Onmanorama that efforts were underway to track down the suspects and trace the Tamil Nadu-registered car they used to escape.
